title: AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern
description:
### **Combine AI with Software Testing | Automate Test Processes | Deliver Quality Software**

### **Job Description**

Wahy Lab Solutions is seeking analytical and technology-driven candidates for the position of AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern. The role focuses on validating software quality using traditional testing methodologies, test automation techniques, and AI-assisted testing tools. Interns will gain practical exposure to intelligent test generation, defect analysis, test optimisation, and AI-driven quality assurance through industry-oriented software projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse software requirements and develop test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
* Execute manual and AI-assisted software testing activities.
* Identify, document, track, and report software defects and inconsistencies.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, usability, and compatibility testing.
* Explore AI-powered tools for test case generation, test data creation, and test result analysis.
* Assist in developing and maintaining automated test scripts.
* Use AI tools to support test coverage analysis and identify potential edge cases.
* Perform API testing and validate application responses and data accuracy.
* Evaluate AI-generated test cases for accuracy, relevance, and completeness.
* Collaborate with developers and QA engineers to investigate and resolve software defects.
* Maintain test documentation, defect reports, and quality assurance records.
* Participate in live projects involving AI-assisted testing and modern quality engineering practices.

### **Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Testing, Quality Assurance (QA), and testing methodologies.
* Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Familiarity with manual testing, test case design, and defect life cycle management.
* Basic understanding of test automation concepts and scripting fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AI tools and Generative AI applications is preferred.
* Awareness of Selenium, Playwright, or similar automation frameworks is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman is beneficial.
* Understanding of prompt engineering for AI-assisted testing is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, documentation, and teamwork abilities.
* Interest in AI-driven software quality engineering and emerging testing technologies.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree / Diploma / PG / ITI.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates interested in Software Testing, Artificial Intelligence, Test Automation, and Quality Engineering are encouraged to apply.

### **Job Details**

* Job Title: AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern
* Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
* Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO) / Work from Home (WFH) / Hybrid
* Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

### **Career Opportunities**

This internship can help candidates prepare for future roles such as:

* AI Test Engineer
* Software QA Engineer
* Test Automation Engineer
* Quality Engineering Analyst
* AI Testing Specialist
* Software Test Analyst

### **Why Join Us?**

* Next-Gen QA Stack: Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge AI testing tools, prompt engineering
for test automation, and Generative AI test generation.* Modern Quality Engineering: Learn how to combine traditional STLC fundamentals with AI-driven edge case discovery and automated regression testing.
* Real Project Workflows: Work alongside software developers and QA teams on production applications to streamline testing cycles.
* Future-Proof Career: Position yourself at the forefront of the software industry by mastering AI-driven quality engineering techniques early in your career.

### **Apply Now and Build Your Future in AI-Driven Software Testing!**

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume on hr@wahylab.com

title: AI Engr.
description:
**AI Engineer**

*iRONic Ventures | Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time | 2 Openings*

**The Role**

We're looking for two AI Engineers to build AI features into a production SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe. You'll work in TypeScript across the stack, connecting LLMs and generative models to a real application: designing prompts and structured outputs, building evaluations and tests around them, and keeping AI suggestions inside the guard rails of validated business logic. This is a product engineering role, not a research or model-training role. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **AI Features:** Design and build LLM-powered features end to end, from prompt and structured output to API, UI, and tests
* **Generative Media:** Integrate image-generation and image-editing models, and measure output quality, latency, and cost per result
* **Guard Rails:** Treat AI output as a proposal that deterministic, validated code checks before anything reaches the user
* **Evaluation:** Build evaluation sets and automated checks so prompt and model changes are compared on evidence, not guessed
* **Data Integration:** Import, map, and validate structured data from external partners, using AI where it saves manual work
* **Configuration Tooling:** Build tools that let non-technical admins configure business rules safely
* **Production:** Add logging and monitoring around expensive AI calls, and troubleshoot and fix production issues
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with the test discipline that keeps their output trustworthy

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years of professional software engineering, including at least one LLM-based feature shipped to production
* **Programming:** Strong TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable writing SQL
* **LLM Engineering:** OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, schema validation (e.g. Zod), tool calling
* **Evaluation & Testing:** Automated tests and evals for code that depends on non-deterministic model output
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, data modelling, and working with messy external data
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Image-generation APIs, vector search (pgvector), job queues (Redis, BullMQ), Next.js and React, three.js, Python for evaluation scripts, German language

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

* **Builders, not just investors:** We're engineers who invest. Product decisions are made by people who read the code
* **AI-native by default:** Coding agents, automated tests, and fast release cycles are how every team works here, not an experiment
* **More than one codebase:** Work across new ventures, our own products, and client builds instead of maintaining one system for years
* **Be early in Kochi:** Join the first engineers in our Kochi office, help shape how it works, and work hand in hand with the team in Berlin
* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

**To Apply**

Upload your resume, your LinkedIn profile, and a short note (3-4 sentences) on why you'd be a great fit for the role. Include one thing you built with AI coding tools and how you checked that it worked.

Pay: From ₹380,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* SaaS: 2 years (Required)
* Node.js: 2 years (Required)

Location:

* Kochi, Kerala (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise\-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response.
